datasets.name: Sentinel-1 IW GRD VV/VH
datasets.provider: Copernicus / ESA; Microsoft Planetary Computer mirror
datasets.role: Three-scene pre-event baseline and event-day acquisition
datasets.licence: Copernicus data use; source attribution required
datasets.access_note: Anonymous temporary SAS signing. No signed URL or credential is stored.

datasets.name: Irish radar files — October 2023 ACRR composite
datasets.source_note: HDF how/nodes values are retained in outputs/validation/rainfall_qc.json. No gauge-based adjustment is applied.

datasets.name: OPW Cork bare-earth LiDAR DTM
datasets.provider: Geological Survey Ireland / Office of Public Works
datasets.role: Nominal catalogue resolution 2 m; delivered raster approximately 0.125 m; 26 intersecting river-corridor tiles aggregated to a 10 m analysis grid
datasets.attribution: Contains Irish Public Sector Data (Geological Survey Ireland & the Office of Public Works) licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence.
datasets.note: River-corridor coverage is sparse; LiDAR has priority where valid but does not cover the full analysis grid.

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.role: Broad-coverage 30 m surface elevation used only where OPW LiDAR is unavailable
datasets.note: This is DSM, not bare-earth DTM. Source boundaries, capture dates and vertical references are documented in terrain_qc.json; no vertical-datum reconciliation is claimed.

datasets.name: EPA Water Framework Directive spatial layers
datasets.role: Catchment context, zonal rainfall summaries and suitable permanent-water geometry
datasets.note: Cycle 3 layers are current management boundaries, not historical flood observations.

datasets.name: Midleton Flood Relief Scheme — Storm Babet Flood Event Report, Draft 2
datasets.role: Event timeline, rainfall context and qualitative flood-mechanism evidence
datasets.restriction: Do not publish report figures, photographs or digitised reference polygons without permission. No numerical accuracy metrics are derived from the restricted reference in this project.

rainfall_context.source: Arup/Cork County Council report, Table 2, page 12
rainfall_context.note: Station point totals and radar area estimates use different spatial and temporal supports. They are context, not a calibration or correction applied to the radar grid.
